cohort: The study cohort consisted of 5960 women who received prenatal care and delivered a live singleton neonate at Kaiser Permanente Bellflower Medical Center between 2005-2010, excluding those with prepregnancy hypertension or prehypertension.
finding: Women who developed a hypertensive disorder in pregnancy or preeclampsia/eclampsia were significantly more likely to develop prehypertension or hypertension in the year after delivery compared to those without pregnancy-related hypertension.
